summary: Backend-only verification of SENDbakēd Driver Multi-Stop Job UX. Ran the new pytest suite tests/test_send_driver_multi_stop_ux.py (13 tests) plus the requested regression suites (test_send_phase_b_capabilities, test_send_phase_c_service_types, test_send_phase_d_between_cities, test_send_phase_e_multi_stop, test_send_phase_f_driver_signup). All 47 tests passed. This covers: stops[] enrichment with sequence/pending statuses, stops_progress shape, delivery_pin scrubbing from customer API, single-shipment backward compat (stops=null, stops_progress=null), stop-advance auth guards (401 without JWT, 401 with customer JWT), strict ordering (cannot skip pickup_1 or drop before its pickup), wrong PIN rejection, no leg replay, and full happy-path cascade to 'delivered'. Frontend testing skipped per request.
critical_code_review_comments: multi_stop.py helpers (enrich_stops, advance_stop_leg, summarise_progress, strip_pins, dispatch_delivery_pins) are well-factored and unit-tested; ordering + PIN enforcement logic is robust.

PIN scrubbing correctly hides drop.delivery_pin from customer-facing serializer; SMS dispatch path exercised via unit tests only — recommend an end-to-end integration test with a real driver JWT once test-credentials for a dispatched multi-stop booking exist.
test_credentials: N/A — new tests bootstrap their own users/JWTs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full multi-stop driver UX backend suite green. If frontend E2E is later requested, a real driver JWT + a dispatched multi-stop booking are required to exercise POST /api/express/bookings/{id}/stop-advance from DriverTripSheet.jsx. Regression baseline: 47 SEND-domain tests pass in ~12s.
